acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures quality and craftsmanship through our integrated design-build process, which keeps all aspects of your Detached ADU project under one accountable team. We meticulously select materials, adhere to stringent building standards, and maintain clear communication throughout every phase. Our 20+ years of experience and more than 10,000 completed jobs in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex attest to our proven track record of delivering customized renovations that stand the test of time, enhancing functionality, beauty, and value.
